scripts.start: (fuser -k 3000/tcp || true) && (fuser -k 4000/tcp || true) && docker compose up -d --wait postgres && concurrently "npm run start:dev --workspace=apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web"
scripts.dev: (fuser -k 3000/tcp || true) && (fuser -k 4000/tcp || true) && docker compose up -d --wait postgres && concurrently "npm run start:dev --workspace=apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
